narrative.overview:
A dark graphite console in which one device sits in focus, drawn as an object, and the only chroma on screen is that lamp's own light. The light reaches the window as a single channel triple, --light ("r g b"), consumed by the bulb glass, the floor pool, an ambient wash, the slider fill, the selected-tile top edge, the selected-pill dot and the lit power button. Everything else is neutral.

Controls have weight: tracks are inset, thumbs and buttons are raised with a 1px inner top highlight and a small downward shadow. The popup is a fixed 360x560 window, one device per screen, switched with pills.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals, warm ink, no second chroma: focus and selection use the warm off-white accent.
Chroma comes only from the focused lamp (--light), plus control tracks that show the value they set.
Physical controls: inset track, cream raised thumb, ringed raised round steppers, raised tiles.
Bahnschrift Light numerals; Segoe UI for everything else.
Exponential ease-out motion; reduced motion respected globally.

rules.name: The Borrowed Light Rule
rules.body: The lamp is the only chroma. Anything that needs colour reads rgb(var(--light) / alpha); nothing else is saturated.

rules.name: The Same Warm White Rule
rules.body: Focus, selection and the primary button share the accent #e9e4da, so interaction never introduces a hue.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Large light numerals are Bahnschrift with tabular figures; no other text uses it.

rules.name: The Offset Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a downward offset. No zero-offset coloured halos.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: Selection on a raised tile is a 2px inset top edge in lamp light, not a fill or outline.

dos: Do route every lamp-derived colour through --light, with alpha.
Do build new controls as inset-or-raised objects with a 1px top highlight and a downward shadow.
Do use var(--ease-out) (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for all transitions; 0.15s press, 0.25 to 0.6s state.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better against graphite and keep the fixed 360x560 frame.
Do give inline SVG gradients per-instance ids.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue; use #e9e4da for focus and selection.
Don't use zero-offset coloured halos or neon glow around controls.
Don't replace the single focused device with a list of identical rows each with a switch.
Don't set the numeral in anything but Bahnschrift Light with tabular figures.
Don't use bare opacity changes for state without a transition, and don't override reduced-motion.
